Use cases

Different tasks. Same gentle entrance.

Gomentum helps when the task is important but the start feels blocked.

Work tasks

You have a report, proposal, or email you keep avoiding.

TaskWrite my client proposal
First moveOpen the document and write only the title.
Try this kind of task

Study tasks

The chapter feels too big, so the first action needs to feel tiny.

TaskStudy chapter 4
First moveOpen the chapter and read only the first heading.
Try this kind of task

Life admin

Small tasks pile up until the list feels heavy.

TaskReply to three messages
First moveOpen one message and write the first sentence.
Try this kind of task

Cleaning or home tasks

The room feels like too much to fix at once.

TaskClean my room
First movePick up five visible items and put them in one place.
Try this kind of task

Creative tasks

The blank page feels harder than the work.

TaskStart my design idea
First moveWrite three rough words about the idea.
Try this kind of task

Overwhelming tasks

The task is real, but your brain cannot find the entrance.

TaskSort everything I need to do
First moveWrite the task name at the top of a blank note.
Try this kind of task

Use it before the pressure builds.

The best moment to use Gomentum is when you notice yourself avoiding the first step.
